identity.title: Qualify OrientedBox3D contracts and pointer interactions

origin.summary: The owner approved the next ranked dependency-ready item. M-12 remained New although OrientedBox3D schema, geometry validation, numeric authoring, and actual pointer smoke already existed; the exact OrientedBox subset had no Runner-owned completeness gate and current runtime evidence was historical.

state.current_summary: Existing schema, shared geometry validation, editor, Viewer handles, and seven-gesture pointer smoke are present. The remaining work is to strengthen the shared headless edge cases, expose an exact Runner/CI subset gate, rerun current Wide/Compact pointer evidence, and record reusable closure evidence.
state.next_action: Extend the existing selection-contract verifier and add the thin Runner/CI qualification route without changing product behavior.

objective.summary: Close M-12 with one reusable OrientedBox3D qualification path covering schema round-trip, fail-closed geometry, actual pointer gestures, and Runner/CI completeness.
constraints: Keep ToolRecipeSelectionContractVerification as the sole schema and geometry assertion owner; add no duplicate verifier framework or geometry implementation.
Reuse the existing OrientedBox editor, Viewer handles, actual Windows pointer smoke, semantic theme, and Shell smoke routing without adding UI behavior or gestures.
Preserve selection identity, authored recipe state, Preview/Publish/Run separation, camera stability, and non-execution during pointer editing.
Exclude new downstream inspection consumers, SDK algorithms, schema-version movement, R0, and platform or hardware expansion.
Store generated local evidence physically under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab-3D-Studio.

criteria.text: The existing shared verifier proves valid schema 1.4/current-schema acceptance, exact rotated center/axes/half-extents save and reopen, old-schema rejection, and mixed-payload rejection.

The same shared verifier fails closed for zero-length, finite non-unit, parallel/non-orthogonal, left-handed, non-finite geometry, and non-positive half-extents without duplicating production geometry logic.

A Runner command reuses the shared verifier, requires every exact OrientedBox3D case, emits a stable complete marker, and the existing hosted contract step requires that marker and full report result.

Fresh current-build Wide 1920x1040 and Compact 1280x760 actual Windows pointer smokes pass all seven Perspective/Top/Side gestures, accessible handles, camera stability, selection identity, no authored recipe or execution mutation, selected-monitor intersection, and contextual screenshot inspection.

Focused and full Release builds, affected selection/teaching/Viewer/Shell regressions, standard test facade, NuGet health, structure guard, fixed Vision SDK package guard, issue validation, documentation targets, repository JSON, inventory recount, and diff hygiene pass on the current tree.

context.summary: Owns current schema, persistence, invalid geometry, and selection payload checks.
Owns finite, positive, orthonormal, and right-handed validation reused by recipe, editor, and Viewer paths.
Owns seven actual Windows pointer gestures across Perspective, Top, and Side projections.
